historical_contemporary_boundary: Hand-held pendulum/ideomotor literature and twentieth-century practitioner systems have different aims. Early historical accounts are secondary leads within the research introduction;no ancient universal yes/no chart protocol attested here. Lethbridge rates/dream claims remain separate from Lonegren calibration and experimental suggestion.

feasibility.first_scope: One named source-bounded manual symbolic response protocol plus explicitly editorial seeded simulator;yes/no with explicit unknown/ambiguous/unmapped outcomes and no factual prediction. Freeze any original chart separately after complete source/sector checks.
feasibility.calibration: Record source/individual signal map without automatic universal directions. Distinguish observed motion,assigned symbolic label and editorial reflection. No-response or contradictory calibration must remain unknown;signal amplitude is not answer confidence.
feasibility.simulation: A seeded categorical draw is a reproducible digital model,not physical ideomotor movement. Weights must be named/explicit exact integers or rationals,not estimated truth probabilities or LLM judgments. PRNG cannot discover an answer from question text.
feasibility.physical_motion: Optional mouse/camera/sensor work is P2. Physical oscillation mechanics,observed user motion and divination interpretation remain separate;no unsupported realism claim.
feasibility.rights: Only metadata and original factual notes ingested. Modern books/charts,web photos,article figures and CC BY-NC material have separate rights;public access does not grant unrestricted redistribution.
